blocks.text: Emerging technologies are new tools, systems and methods being developed or newly used: AI, cloud computing, blockchain, IoT, AR and VR, quantum computing and biotechnology among them. In cloud computing, virtualization runs many virtual machines on one physical machine, scalability adds resources when needed, and on-demand access provides them instantly; IaaS offers infrastructure and PaaS a complete development platform. In blockchain, a peer-to-peer network of nodes shares a ledger directly, without a central server.
